confidence_legend.MEASURED: sourced from an operator-supplied number or the task brief itself
confidence_legend.UNVERIFIED_HEURISTIC: common Upwork-practitioner wisdom or an educated guess with no data behind it yet; treat as a starting point to be corrected by the first 20 real proposals

bid_if_all_of.rationale: keyword set drawn from the operator's actual niche language, not a generic 'AI' keyword list; no click-through data exists yet on which of these actually correlate with a fit
standard Upwork practitioner floor; excludes the highest-risk non-paying segment
a client with zero platform spend history has an unknown, possibly-zero probability of actually hiring; $1,000 is a common practitioner floor, not a measured cutoff for this operator
clients who post and never hire waste a Connect regardless of fit; 40% is a guess, not a measured threshold

skip_if_any_of.rationale: disqualifies full-build asks (different skill/scope than a reliability audit) and unpaid/equity-only asks; wording list is a guess to be tightened after real postings are seen
explicit threshold named in the task brief: '50+ proposals already' disqualifies
floor is a placeholder pending the operator's actual [RATE] in PROFILE.md; set 15-20% below the operator's real rate once known, not guessed independently of it
matches render_proposal.py --max-age-days default (7); the two must be kept in sync by hand until one config feeds both

preferred_but_not_required.rationale: the 50-proposal line is a hard disqualifier; a much lower count is where realistic odds of being read actually live, per general Upwork practitioner wisdom -- no data of this operator's own yet
soft preference for payment-friction-free geographies; not a disqualifier on its own
